text: This report recommends approval of an application to amend the Zoning By-law to permit a mixed-use development consisting of ten mixed-use buildings ranging in height from 18 to 46 storeys (60 to 145 metres), and two 7-storey non-residential buildings (30 metres each). The proposal includes a total of 4,077 dwelling units, including affordable housing units in accordance with Site and Area Specific Policy 432, and a minimum of 2,893 square metres of non-residential gross floor area. The two 7-storey buildings are within the General Employment Areas, and proposed employment uses are in conformity with the Official Plan.
